tagline: A free toolkit for architecture students
intro: Quick studio tools, a growing precedent library, and practical help for juries and portfolios. Free, open, and made by students.

sections.title: Studio Tools
sections.description: Small calculators and helpers for everyday studio work.

items.title: Concept Planner
items.description: Go from brief, site and climate to a concept sketch and statement in five guided steps.

items.title: Scale Converter
items.description: Convert between real size and drawing size at 1:50, 1:100, 1:200, 1:500 or any custom scale.

items.title: Area Calculator
items.description: Work out room and site areas in square metres and square feet.

items.title: Floor Plan Studio
items.description: Draw accurate plans with walls, doors, windows, furniture, dimensions and room areas. Export PNG and DXF.

sections.title: Precedent Library
sections.description: Case studies of notable buildings, organised by type, climate and architect.

items.title: Housing
items.description: Apartments, row houses and community housing projects.

items.title: Public Buildings
items.description: Libraries, museums, schools and civic spaces.

items.title: Climate-Responsive Design
items.description: Projects that respond well to sun, wind and rain.

sections.title: Jury & Portfolio Help
sections.description: Guidance for presenting your work with confidence.

items.title: Jury Preparation Checklist
items.description: What to pin up, what to say, and what to expect.

items.title: Sheet Layout Guide
items.description: Simple rules for clear, readable presentation sheets.

items.title: Portfolio Basics
items.description: How to choose, order and present your best projects.

sections.title: Resources
sections.description: Standards, references and free software worth knowing.

items.title: Standard Dimensions
items.description: Common furniture, door, stair and parking sizes.
